meta.subject: AI (BCSE306L Artificial Intelligence)
meta.probability_formula: probability = (2*k_recent + k_older + 1) / (2*n_recent + n_older + 2); k = papers containing the topic, n = papers; recent = 2026-27. Primary 'probability' uses BCSE306L FAT papers only (n_recent=1, n_older=6). 'probability_all_papers' uses CAT1/CAT2/FAT papers whose syllabus window covers the topic's module (CAT1=M1-M3, CAT2=M3-M5, FAT=M1-M7; observed).
meta.papers_used_detail: 25 distinct BCSE306L papers (7 FAT, 11 CAT1, 7 CAT2) after merging QP/AK duplicates; sister-course papers (BITE308L, BECE309L, CSI3003) used only for sister comparison
meta.tag_agreement_detail: orchestrator re-read of 35/344 questions: type 30/35, bloom 30/35, scenario wrapper 33/35, text 34/35
meta.small_n_warning: Only one 2026-27 FAT (B1) exists, so 'recent' FAT evidence is a single paper. Treat probabilities as ranks, not calibrated chances.
